ayuda.title: How does the platform work?
ayuda.subtitle: Everything you need to know to use MKTG Platform, based on what your account can see and do.

dashboard.introPost: shows a performance summary of all your connected ad platforms in one place: total spend, impressions, clicks, conversions and ROAS.
dashboard.bullet1: Filter by date range and platform
dashboard.bullet2: Automatically alerts you if a campaign drops more than 30% vs the previous period
dashboard.bullet3: Trends and variations compared to the previous period

campanas.intro: Detailed table of all campaigns across all platforms. You can sort, filter and export the data.

analisisIA.title: AI Analysis — The Triad
analisisIA.introPre: Choose platforms and a date range: three models debate your real metrics from different angles, in a conversation you can follow question by question. Every debate is saved — you can pick it up later or ask
analisisIA.introPost: to summarize it right in the Home chat.
analisisIA.chatgpt: creative strategist, with web search for local context
analisisIA.llama: pragmatic moderator, synthesis and action plan

precios.introPost: prices (searched on the spot, no database of our own) across 13 Uruguayan chains: supermarkets (Disco, Devoto, Géant, Ta-Ta, El Dorado), pharmacies (FarmaShop, Botiga) and appliances/electronics (Fama, Stienda, Black Dog, Cover Company, DIMM, Electrohogar). Appliance prices are often in dollars — each result shows its real currency, it's not auto-converted.

filtros.title: Filters stack up
filtros.desc: Chain chips add up as you tap them (multi-select) — only the "All" chip turns them all off at once.

grafico.title: Comparison chart
grafico.desc: "View chart" button: pick which products go in with a searchable checklist, and you can load your own price to see where you stand against the competition.

precios.donTinoPre: You can also ask for a product's price directly to
precios.donTinoPost: in the Home chat, without going to this screen.

cenefas.intro: Turn an Excel of products into a print-ready PowerPoint deck. The system automatically generates the slides with formatted prices, descriptions and promotions.

destino.title: Choose a destination
destino.desc: When you enter you choose where to go: RedExpress (order sheets and combo/multi-buy mechanics) or Weekend Price Crash (current price, crossed-out previous price and validity dates).

excel.title: Upload the Excel
excel.desc: Load the file with the products. Automatically detected columns include DESCRIPCION, PRECIO, OFERTA, CATEGORIA, etc.

preview.title: Check the preview
preview.desc: Before downloading you can see a reference preview with the real data loaded.

confirmar.title: Confirm and download
confirmar.desc: The PPTX is generated in seconds. You can download the result from the same screen.

canvas.title: Visual canvas
canvas.desc: Konva.js-based WYSIWYG editor. See in real time how each component will look in the chosen format.

reglas.title: Visibility rules
reglas.desc: Define when each component appears based on the product's data. AND/OR/NOT conditions with multiple operators.

variables.title: Variables
variables.desc: Map each Excel field to a template component: price, description, mechanic, combo, etc.

predeterminada.title: Default template
predeterminada.desc: A4, Pinchos or 3xA4 banner, already configured and ready to use.

importar.title: Import PPTX
importar.descPre: Upload your own .pptx and the placeholders

desdeCero.title: From scratch
desdeCero.desc: Create each component by hand, define bounds, styles and transforms.

conexiones.title: Platform connections
conexiones.introPost: you connect each ad account. Tokens are stored encrypted. Once connected, syncing is automatic.

historial.introPost: you'll find every banner generation job: status, format used, date and the download button (available for 24h after generation).

pedidos.title: Order sheet
pedidos.intro: Each RedExpres store places its monthly order for point-of-sale material (banners, posters, skewers, stickers) by filling in its row of the month's sheet. Changes save on their own a few seconds after you stop typing — there's no "Save" button.

tuLocal.title: Your store
tuLocal.desc: You can only edit the row of the store assigned to you — the rest is visible but can't be touched.

confirmar.title: Confirm order
confirmar.desc: Once loaded, you confirm the order and the row gets locked to avoid accidental changes.

nuevoMes.title: New month
nuevoMes.desc: Only the Super Admin can open a new month or unlock an already-confirmed order.

asistente.title: Virtual assistant
asistente.introPost: (Llama 3.3 70B via Groq) knows every feature of the platform and can also do things for you, not just describe them:
asistente.feature1: Look up a product's price across the 13 chains, live
asistente.feature2: Check the status of a banner generation job by its ID
asistente.footer: Available from Home — open the chat card below Don Tino's greeting.

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.introPre: There are no separate teams or organizations: all users share the same platform. Permissions live
roles.introMid: not per role — the role only sets the starting point when assigned; after that, each permission is toggled individually from that person's profile in the

superAdmin.title: Super Admin
superAdmin.desc: Full unrestricted access. Reserved for the main account — not assignable from the panel.

admin.title: Admin
admin.desc: Starts with every permission checked; individual ones can be unchecked per user. Can't modify another Admin or the Super Admin.

usuario.title: User
usuario.desc: Starts with a standard operational set (full banners, analytics, prices and AI, no user or connection management) — adjustable per person.

viewer.title: Viewer
viewer.desc: Starts with no permissions and can only have "view" permissions checked — never generate, edit, delete or manage.
